research.angle: Industrialisation is linked to a biological mismatch where nature-adapted human biology faces novel challenges and increased stress in modern environments.
research.verdict: The sources suggest that industrialisation has created a biological and environmental mismatch for humans, but they do not provide specific evidence that it fundamentally rewired attention spans or neural processing.
research.caveat: The sources do not contain any data regarding industrial time-keeping or specific changes to human attention spans.
